# Zenith Line Co., Kuwait

Zenith Line is a Kuwait-based construction, engineering, infrastructure, telecom, IT, trading and technical supply company.

Official website: https://zenithlinekw.com/
Contact: info@zenithlinekw.com
Primary phone and WhatsApp: +965 66488191
Office: Mirqab, Kuwait City

## Service categories

- Construction and renovation
- Civil, road and infrastructure works
- K-Span and shade structures
- HVAC services
- Specialized civil and concrete services
- Import, export, supply and logistics
- Engineering, manpower, tools and equipment

- https://zenithlinekw.com/services/telecom-it/ — Telecom and IT service hub
- https://zenithlinekw.com/services/wired-network/ — fibre and copper wired network routes

- https://zenithlinekw.com/services/structured-cabling/ — structured copper and fibre cabling

- https://zenithlinekw.com/services/pbx-telephone-exchange/ — PBX, IP telephone and business VoIP systems
- https://zenithlinekw.com/services/door-access-security/ — door access control and security
- https://zenithlinekw.com/services/public-address-systems/ — paging and public address systems
- https://zenithlinekw.com/services/router-wifi/ — business Wi-Fi, routers and access points
- https://zenithlinekw.com/services/network-security/ — firewalls, VPN and network segmentation
- https://zenithlinekw.com/services/installation-support/ — project-based IT installation and support
